responses.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) t

assumptions.assumption: Track count per media type is the number of tracks passing the Bytes filter (COUNT(*)); since Bytes > threshold excludes NULLs and Milliseconds is NOT NULL, this equals the number of tracks used in the ratio average.
Bytes is cast to REAL before dividing to avoid integer division (SQLite-style syntax); Milliseconds is assumed non-zero.

assumptions.assumption: Track count per media type is the number of tracks passing the Bytes > 10323804 filter (COUNT(*)); since the filter excludes NULL Bytes, every counted track has a non-missing ratio.

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(bpm) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(cnt) AS avg_track_count FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bpm, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) t

assumptions.assumption: Division is done in floating point (not integer division), so bytes per millisecond is fractional. Milliseconds is assumed non-zero (it is NOT NULL and is a duration).
Track count per media type is the count of tracks passing the Bytes filter (all have non-null Bytes because of the filter).
